limitations: One development smoke case and one repetition per harness support only a bounded development claim.
Recorded smoke runs used the behaviorally identical predecessor package; the moved package changes only corpus links from source-repository-relative paths to canonical repository URLs.
No no-skill control, automatic-routing run, held-out outcome case, Pi run, production activation, or human-rework measure is recorded.
The artifact grader reflects this repository's evidence, telemetry, route, safety, and release requirements; it is not a universal skill-quality score.
